title: Never Left Alone
story:
A little boy was waiting outside his school after classes ended.

One by one, the other children were picked up by their parents.

As the playground grew quiet, he began to wonder if someone had forgotten him.

Just then, his grandfather hurried through the school gate with a warm smile.

He gently hugged the boy and said,

“I would never leave you behind. I came as quickly as I could.”

The boy's fear disappeared as they walked home hand in hand.

Sometimes we may feel lonely or forgotten.

People may disappoint us, and even those closest to us may not always be there.

But God never abandons His children.

His love is constant, and His presence never leaves us.

Even when everyone else fails us, the Lord receives us with open arms and faithfully walks beside us.
life_lesson: Even when people fail or leave us, God never abandons His children. His love and presence remain with us forever.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for never leaving or forsaking me.

When I feel lonely or forgotten, remind me that You are always near.

Help me to trust Your unfailing love and rest in Your faithful presence.

May I find my security in You alone.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt alone or forgotten?

How does God's promise to receive you bring comfort today?

How can you encourage someone else who may be feeling lonely?
verse: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.
